beliefs.belief: On Earth I'd call it a coxsackie-type virus. But Juuso has eleven years on that world and says no match and an insect vector; she knows her patients.
Gut virus; water and hands first. If the reedflies are in it at all, they're passengers. I deferred to Juuso too quickly.
Asked the right question about the stool before I did. He's serious.
